title: Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo
description: Imininingwane I Need Save eyicubungulayo uma usebenzisa le webhusayithi, amakhukhi namathuluzi okuhlaziya eyisebenzisayo, namalungelo akho phezu kwemininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu.
body:
I Need Save (ineedsave.com) iyithuluzi lamahhala lokulanda amavidiyo, izithombe nomsindo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, eliphethwe ngu-Abid Hanan Wicaksono. Le nqubomgomo ichaza ukuthi yimiphi imininingwane esiyicubungulayo uma usebenzisa le webhusayithi nokuthi siyiphatha kanjani. Ngamabomu siqoqa imininingwane encane ngangokunokwenzeka: akudingeki ukuthi ubhalise, ungene ngemvume, noma unikeze igama lakho noma i-imeyili yakho ukuze usebenzise le sevisi.

Imininingwane esiyicubungulayo

  • Amalinki owanamathiselayo. Ilinki ithunyelwa kuseva yethu kuphela ukuze kutholakale imidiya engalandwa. Asiwagcini amalinki kusizindalwazi (database) futhi asiwaxhumanisi nokuthi ungubani.
  • Amafayela emidiya. Noma nini lapho kunokwenzeka, isiphequluli sakho silanda ifayela ngqo kumaseva enkundla yokuqala (isibonelo i-Instagram, i-Facebook, noma i-X). Uma ifayela kufanele licutshungulwe (isibonelo, ukuhlanganisa ividiyo nomsindo noma ukuguqulela ku-MP3), noma uma inkundla ingavumeli ukulanda ngqo, lidluliswa ngokusakazwa kuseva yethu liye kudivayisi yakho ngaphandle kokugcinwa.
  • Imininingwane yobuchwepheshe. Njengawo cishe wonke amawebhusayithi, umhlinzeki wethu wokusingatha (Vercel) urekhoda imininingwane yobuchwepheshe yezicelo, efana nekheli le-IP, uhlobo lwesiphequluli, nesikhathi sokufinyelela, ngenhloso yokuphepha nokusebenza. Lawa marekhodi agcinwa okwesikhashana kuphela ngokwezinqubomgomo zeVercel.
  • Izibalo zezindatshana. Inani lokubukwa, lokuthandwa nokwabiwa ligcinwa njengesamba sendatshana ngayinye, ngaphandle kwanoma iyiphi imininingwane ekuhlonzayo.

Amakhukhi nesitoreji sesiphequluli

  • ins-lang: ikhumbula ulimi olukhethile, isikhathi esingangonyaka owodwa.
  • dl_…: ikhukhi lesikhashana elihlala imizuzwana embalwa elikhombisa ukuthi ukulanda sekuqalile.
  • Isitoreji sendawo (localStorage ne-sessionStorage): sikhumbula izindatshana ozithandile futhi sivimbela ukuthi ukuvakasha okukodwa kubalwe kabili. Le mininingwane ihlala kudivayisi yakho.
  • Amakhukhi okuhlaziya eqembu lesithathu avela ku-Google Analytics naku-Microsoft Clarity, achazwe ngezansi.

Ukuhlaziya

Sisebenzisa amathuluzi okuhlaziya ukuze siqonde ukuthi iwebhusayithi isetshenziswa kanjani futhi siyithuthukise:

  • Vercel Web Analytics: izibalo zokuvakasha ezingadaluli ukuthi ungubani, ngaphandle kwamakhukhi.
  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): isebenzisa amakhukhi ukukala amakhasi owavulayo, izwe okulo ngokulinganiselwa, uhlobo lwedivayisi yakho, nezehlakalo ezifana nokuchofoza izinkinobho zokulanda. Imininingwane icutshungulwa yi-Google ngaphansi kweNqubomgomo Yobumfihlo ye-Google.
  • Microsoft Clarity: ilayishwa lapho nje uqala ukusebenzisana nekhasi. I-Clarity irekhoda ukusebenzisana okufana nokuchofoza nokuskrola ukuze kwenziwe ama-heatmap nokuqoshwa kwamaseshini, futhi ifihla lokho okuthayipha ezindaweni zokufaka umbhalo. Imininingwane icutshungulwa yi-Microsoft ngaphansi kweSitatimende Sobumfihlo se-Microsoft.

Ungaphuma ekuhlaziyeni ngokuvimba amakhukhi eqembu lesithathu kuzilungiselelo zesiphequluli sakho, ngokusebenzisa isivimbi sokulandelela (tracker blocker), noma ngokufaka i-Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. Iwebhusayithi isasebenziseka ngokugcwele.

Amasevisi eqembu lesithathu

  • Vercel Inc. inikeza ukusingatha (hosting). Amaseva ayo angase atholakale ngaphandle kwezwe lakho.
  • Google Fonts isetshenziselwa ukubonisa ezinye izinhlamvu zokubhala (isibonelo ezesi-Arabhu, ezesi-Thai, noma ezesi-Japani). Uma ifonti ilayisha, ikheli lakho le-IP liyabonakala ku-Google.
  • Inkundla yokuqala yemidiya. Uma ifayela lilandwa ngqo, leyo nkundla ingabona ikheli lakho le-IP, njengalapho uvula okuqukethwe ngokwakho.
  • Izinkinobho zokwabelana (WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Telegram) zixhumana nalawo masevisi kuphela uma uzichofoza.

Ukuphepha nokwabelana

Konke ukuxhumana nale webhusayithi kusebenzisa i-HTTPS. Asiyidayisi, asiyiqashisi, futhi asihwebi ngemininingwane yomuntu siqu. Imininingwane yabelwana kuphela nabahlinzeki bamasevisi abashiwo ngenhla, ngezinga elidingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe iwebhusayithi, noma uma kudingwa ngumthetho.

Izingane

Le sevisi ayihloselwe izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-13, futhi asiqoqi ngokwazi imininingwane yomuntu siqu ezinganeni.

Amalungelo akho

Kuye ngokuthi uhlalaphi (isibonelo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kwemininingwane Yomuntu Siqu wase-Indonesia, uMthetho No. 27 ka-2022, noma uMthethonqubo Jikelele Wokuvikelwa Kwemininingwane weNyunyana YaseYurophu (GDPR)), ungaba nelungelo lokufinyelela, lokulungisa, noma lokususa imininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu kanye nelungelo lokuhoxisa imvume yokuthi icutshungulwe. Ngenxa yokuthi cishe asigcini imininingwane ekuhlonzayo, iningi lezicelo lingasingathwa kalula ngokusula amakhukhi asesiphequlini sakho. Ngemininingwane ecutshungulwa yi-Google noma i-Microsoft, ungasebenzisa nezilungiselelo zobumfihlo zamasevisi abo. Kunoma yini enye, xhumana nathi.

Izinguquko kule nqubomgomo

Le nqubomgomo ingabuyekezwa ngezikhathi ezithile. Izinguquko ziqala ukusebenza lapho zishicilelwa kuleli khasi, kanye nosuku lokuqala ukusebenza olukhonjiswe phezulu.

Xhumana nathi

Imibuzo mayelana nale nqubomgomo ingathunyelwa ngamalinki okuxhumana angezansi kwekhasi ngalinye noma nge-abidhanan.my.id.
